The available models are steady-state process units on material streams (mixers, heaters, flashes, reactors). The case is a multi-period grid-expansion optimization. The case data doesn't map to any of them.

```json
{"case_id": "official_gtep_5bus_resource_adequacy", "status": "limitation", "revision_id": null, "job_id": null, "limitation": {"reasons": [{"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "GTEPData"}, {"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "InvestmentStage"}, {"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "DispatchStage"}, {"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "TransmissionNetwork"}, {"kind": "unit_unavailable", "subject": "ExpansionPlan"}, {"kind": "property_route_unavailable", "subject": "egret_prescient"}, {"kind": "property_route_unavailable", "subject": "pyomo_gdp"}, {"kind": "not_steady_state_simulation", "subject": null}], "explanation": "This OpenFlowsheet version offers only steady-state chemical-process unit models: mixers, splitters, heaters, flashes, reactors, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, feed sources and product sinks. They carry material and energy streams with component flows, T and P. The case is a multi-stage, multi-period power-grid expansion optimization covering investment, dispatch and a CP transmission network. It needs grid data, investment, dispatch, transmission and expansion-plan units, and the egret_prescient and pyomo_gdp packages. None of these exist here. The case is also not a steady-state simulation, and optimization tasks are refused. Building it from process units would be a substitute, so nothing was built."}, "claims": []}
```
